description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between perplexity and the parameter M (likely representing a pruning or layer configuration variable) for three different models: LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B. The x-axis, labeled “M,” ranges from 3 to 8 with integer tick marks at each whole number, indicating discrete values of M. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity,” spans from approximately 15 to 45, with major tick marks at intervals of 10 (20, 30, 40). The blue line with triangle markers, representing Vicuna-7B, starts at a perplexity of ~41 at M=3, decreases to ~35 at M=5, remains relatively flat through M=7, then rises slightly to ~40 at M=8. The green line with circle markers, corresponding to LLaMA1-7B, begins at ~28 at M=3, dips to ~25 at M=5, then gradually increases to ~36 at M=8. The orange line with star markers, for LLaMA1-13B, starts at ~20 at M=3, declines slightly to ~17 at M=5, remains stable through M=7, and rises to ~20 at M=8. All three lines show relatively smooth trends with minor fluctuations, suggesting a stable relationship between M and perplexity for each model under the conditions tested.
